judges: And Equality For Women Came To Know J.
case_name: Association For Social Justice & ... v. Union Of India & Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Association For Social Justice & Research, petitioner

facts_of_case: The Association for Social Justice and Research filed a petition for habeas corpus to trace minor child Chandni @ Chandrawati. The girl's parents had married her off at the age of 11-12 to a 40-year-old man. The petitioner constituted a fact-finding inquiry, which found that the father had kept the girl in hiding.

legal_principles.principle: Child marriage is a violation of human rights, compromising the development of girls and often resulting in early pregnancy and social isolation.
legal_principles.held: In actuality, child marriage is a violation of human rights, compromising the development of girls and often resulting in early pregnancy and social isolation.

legal_principles.principle: Girls who get married at an early age are often more susceptible to the health risks associated with early sexual initiation and childbearing.
legal_principles.held: Girls who get married at an early age are often more susceptible to the health risks associated with early sexual initiation and childbearing, including HIV and obstetric fistula.
use_in: cases involving health risks associated with early marriage

outcome.final_order: The court directed the concerned Police Station to trace and produce the girl. The Crime Branch succeeded in tracing the girl, who was produced on 11.05.2010. The father and husband were arrested and remanded to judicial custody.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for habeas corpus
assisting in cases of child marriage
